description: Unofficial macOS microphone fix for Plasmo Voice 2.0.9 in RPM RolePlay

mods.name: Plasmo Voice 2.0.9 macOS Mic Fix
mods.description: Backports two Java Sound input-device lifecycle fixes for Plasmo Voice 2.0.9 on macOS.

releases.notes:
## Changes

- Replace all zsh tooling with one Bash 3.2-compatible `build.sh`.
- Remove RPM installer, LaunchAgent, source-archive, and manifest helpers.
- Clean `dist/` during builds and emit only the ready-to-install mod JAR.
- Enable the fix in compatible Fabric clients instead of requiring the RPM launcher marker.
- Require Minecraft 1.20.4 and Plasmo Voice 2.0.9 in `fabric.mod.json`.
- Update English and Russian documentation.

mods.name: Plasmo Voice 2.0.9 macOS Mic Fix
mods.description: Backports two Java Sound input-device lifecycle fixes for RPM RolePlay without replacing Plasmo Voice.

releases.notes:
First public release of the unofficial client-only macOS microphone fix for Plasmo Voice 2.0.9 in RPM RolePlay.

## Changes

- Fix the inverted Java Sound input close condition.
- Close the current input device before opening a replacement.
- Add persistent RPM RolePlay installation for macOS.
- Stay inactive outside RPM and with Plasmo Voice versions other than 2.0.9.
- Add English and Russian documentation.

## Compatibility

- macOS
- Minecraft 1.20.4
- Fabric Loader 0.15.0 or newer
- Plasmo Voice exactly 2.0.9
- Java 17 or newer
